# Haplotype Comparitive analyses

### Frequencies and enrichment in chromosome arms

#### Load packages and load function for region based plotting

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrastr)
library(cowplot)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)
library(scatterpie)
library(paletteer)
```

### Core region function

Loading it within file to make additions

24 August 2026: GO terms integrated within the function.

25 August 2026: entire chromosome will be the focus first, so chromosome-wide changes are integrated. The code is adjusted so that it can easily switch between entire chromosome or region based plots, based on position range provided.

24 September 2026: split into a file for full chromosome plotting, to accommodate pathway names in plots (vs. focusing only on genes of interest in the region plot)

```{r}
Reg_GOplot <- function(ChArm, StPos, EnPos)
{
  # temp test values
  # ChArm <- "3R"
  
  pool.snp <- readRDS(file = "/home/srikantv/Flying_Flies_Phenotyping/Big_data/FF_genomes_filtered.RDS")
  
  freq_coords <- pool.snp %>% filter(CHROM == ChArm)
  
  # Use this code for entire chromosome plots
  #StPos <- as.integer(min(freq_coords$POS))
  #EnPos <- as.integer(max(freq_coords$POS))
  
  
  # Use this code for region based plots
  # StPos <- as.integer(10000000)
  # EnPos <- as.integer(20000000)
  # 
  
  psnp <- readRDS(paste0("/home/srikantv/Flying_Flies_Phenotyping/Big_data/lm_targetSNPs.RDS"))
  
  psnp <- psnp |>
    filter(CHROM == ChArm & POS >= StPos & POS <= EnPos)
  
  #get mean freq per haplotype
  #get difference from mean for each 
  #put in long format
  
  ff <- readRDS(file = paste0("../../../Big_data/Haplotype_Inf/Array_HapFreq_", ChArm, ".Rds"))
  
  
  posL <- as.integer(str_split(dimnames(ff)[[1]], "_", simplify = TRUE)[,2])
  posL <- posL[posL >= StPos & posL <= EnPos]
  ff <- ff[paste0(ChArm,"_",posL),,]
  
  ffdiff <- ff
  
  for(ii in 1:8){
    
    pmeans <- rowMeans(ff[,ii,])
    ffdiff[,ii,] <- ff[,ii,]-pmeans
    
  }
  
  pp <- str_split(dimnames(ffdiff)[[1]], "_", simplify = TRUE)
  
  fdat_long <- data.frame("CHROM"= rep(pp[,1],times = 64),
                          "POS" = rep(as.integer(pp[,2]),times = 64),
                          "Pool" = rep(dimnames(ffdiff)[[3]],each=nrow(pp), times= 8),
                          "Linetype" = rep(c("FP","CON"),each = nrow(pp)*4,times=8),
                          "Haplotype" = rep(dimnames(ffdiff)[[2]], each = 8*nrow(pp)),
                          "Freq" = c(ffdiff[,1,1],
                                     ffdiff[,1,2],
                                     ffdiff[,1,3],
                                     ffdiff[,1,4],
                                     ffdiff[,1,5],
                                     ffdiff[,1,6],
                                     ffdiff[,1,7],
                                     ffdiff[,1,8],
                                     ffdiff[,2,1],
                                     ffdiff[,2,2],
                                     ffdiff[,2,3],
                                     ffdiff[,2,4],
                                     ffdiff[,2,5],
                                     ffdiff[,2,6],
                                     ffdiff[,2,7],
                                     ffdiff[,2,8],
                                     ffdiff[,3,1],
                                     ffdiff[,3,2],
                                     ffdiff[,3,3],
                                     ffdiff[,3,4],
                                     ffdiff[,3,5],
                                     ffdiff[,3,6],
                                     ffdiff[,3,7],
                                     ffdiff[,3,8],
                                     ffdiff[,4,1],
                                     ffdiff[,4,2],
                                     ffdiff[,4,3],
                                     ffdiff[,4,4],
                                     ffdiff[,4,5],
                                     ffdiff[,4,6],
                                     ffdiff[,4,7],
                                     ffdiff[,4,8],
                                     ffdiff[,5,1],
                                     ffdiff[,5,2],
                                     ffdiff[,5,3],
                                     ffdiff[,5,4],
                                     ffdiff[,5,5],
                                     ffdiff[,5,6],
                                     ffdiff[,5,7],
                                     ffdiff[,5,8],
                                     ffdiff[,6,1],
                                     ffdiff[,6,2],
                                     ffdiff[,6,3],
                                     ffdiff[,6,4],
                                     ffdiff[,6,5],
                                     ffdiff[,6,6],
                                     ffdiff[,6,7],
                                     ffdiff[,6,8],
                                     ffdiff[,7,1],
                                     ffdiff[,7,2],
                                     ffdiff[,7,3],
                                     ffdiff[,7,4],
                                     ffdiff[,7,5],
                                     ffdiff[,7,6],
                                     ffdiff[,7,7],
                                     ffdiff[,7,8],
                                     ffdiff[,8,1],
                                     ffdiff[,8,2],
                                     ffdiff[,8,3],
                                     ffdiff[,8,4],
                                     ffdiff[,8,5],
                                     ffdiff[,8,6],
                                     ffdiff[,8,7],
                                     ffdiff[,8,8]
                          ))
  
  
  
  #add snp
  
  
  pool.snp <- pool.snp |>
    filter(CHROM == ChArm & POS >= StPos & POS <= EnPos)
  
  freq.snp <- pool.snp |>
    dplyr::select(starts_with("freq_"))
  
  mm <- rowMeans(freq.snp)
  
  #checked this does the diff correct
  sc.freq <- freq.snp - mm
  
  snp_rb <- data.frame("CHROM"= rep(pool.snp$CHROM, times = 8),
                       "POS" = rep(pool.snp$POS, times = 8),
                       "Pool" = rep(dimnames(ffdiff)[[3]],each=nrow(pool.snp)),
                       "Linetype" = rep(c("FP","CON"),each = nrow(pool.snp)*4),
                       "Haplotype" = rep("SNP",nrow(pool.snp)*8),
                       "Freq" = c(sc.freq[,5],
                                  sc.freq[,6],
                                  sc.freq[,7],
                                  sc.freq[,8],
                                  sc.freq[,1],
                                  sc.freq[,2],
                                  sc.freq[,3],
                                  sc.freq[,4]))
  
  fdat_long <- rbind(fdat_long, snp_rb)
  
  phap <- readRDS(file = paste0("../../../Big_data/Haplotype_Inf/HapScan_Padj.Rds"))
  
  phap_chrom <- phap %>% rename(CHROM = ChArm, POS = Ppos) %>% filter(CHROM == ChArm) 
  phap <- phap[phap$ChArm==ChArm & phap$Ppos >= StPos & phap$Ppos <= EnPos & phap$Padj <= 0.05,]


  hplot <- ggplot(fdat_long, aes(POS/1e6,Freq, color = Linetype)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = phap$Ppos/1e6, linewidth = 0.5, color = "grey25", alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = psnp$POS/1e6, linewidth = 0.5, color = "gold") +
    geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 1/6) +
    facet_grid(Haplotype ~.) +
    xlab("Position (MB)") +
    ylab("Frequency") +
    scale_color_manual(name = "Selection",
    values = c("CON" = 'steelblue', "FP" = 'firebrick')) + 
    guides(color = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(size = 4, alpha = 1))) +
    labs(title = paste0("Differences in mapping SNPs to founder haplotypes\nChromosome Arm: ", ChArm)) +
    theme_cowplot() +
    theme(legend.title = element_text(face = 'bold'),
        legend.position = 'top')
  
  
  # Plotting ranking of founder lines in contributing to differences
  hapdata_raw <- readRDS(file = paste0("../../../Big_data/Haplotype_Inf/HapScan_", ChArm, ".Rds"))
  
  hapdata_raw <- hapdata_raw %>% 
    rename(CHROM = ChArm, POS = Ppos) %>% 
    filter(CHROM == ChArm, POS >= StPos & POS <= EnPos)
  
  hapdiff <- hapdata_raw %>% left_join(phap_chrom, by = c("CHROM","POS","MA_D"))
    
  hapdiff_sig <- hapdiff %>% filter(Padj <= 0.05) %>% 
  dplyr::select(CHROM, POS, ends_with("_D"), Padj) %>% 
    pivot_longer(
      cols = contains("_D"),
      names_pattern = "(.*)\\_D",
      names_to = "Founder",
      values_to = "Difference"
      )
  
  hapdiff_ranks <- hapdiff_sig %>% 
    # Remove overall difference (MA) 
    filter(Founder != "MA") %>% 
    group_by(CHROM, POS) %>% 
    # ranks founders at each significant genomic position by their difference values
    # (difference between CON and FP)
    mutate(F_Rank = dense_rank(dplyr::desc(Difference))) %>% 
    ungroup() 
  
  # Mean rank per founder line
  mrank_founders <- hapdiff_ranks %>% group_by(Founder) %>% 
    summarise(mrank = mean(F_Rank))
  
  # Rank plot
  ranks_counts <- hapdiff_ranks %>%
    mutate(Founder = factor(Founder)) %>% 
    filter(F_Rank %in% 1:3) %>% 
    mutate(rank_label = case_when(
      F_Rank == 1 ~ "1st",
      F_Rank == 2 ~ "2nd",
      F_Rank == 3 ~ "3rd"
    ), rank_label = factor(rank_label, levels = c("1st", "2nd", "3rd"))
    ) %>% 
    group_by(Founder, rank_label, .drop = FALSE) %>% 
    summarise(countrank = n())
  
  mrank_labels <- ranks_counts %>% left_join(mrank_founders, by = "Founder") %>% group_by(Founder, .drop = FALSE) %>% 
    summarise(sumcounts = sum(countrank), mrank = mean(mrank))
  
  ranks_plot <- ggplot(ranks_counts) + 
  geom_col(aes( x = Founder, y = countrank, fill = rank_label), 
           position = position_stack(reverse = T), width = 0.8) +
  geom_text(data = mrank_labels, aes(
    x = Founder, y = sumcounts, label = round(mrank, 2)), 
    size = 4, fontface = "bold", vjust = -0.3) +
  scale_fill_paletteer_d("ggsci::default_nejm", direction = -1) +
  labs(x = "Founder Line", y = "Count in given rank", 
      title = paste0("Number of times founder lines contribute the most to significant sites\nChromosome Arm: ", ChArm), 
      fill = "Rank in signficant site") + theme_cowplot()
  
  #print(ranks_plot)
  
  # Load GO terms and genes list
  GOdata <- readRDS(file = paste0("../../../Big_data/hap_GO_enrich.RDS"))
  GOhap <- GOdata %>% filter(CHROM == ChArm, 
                 POS >= StPos & POS <= EnPos,
                 adj_p <= 0.05)
  
  
  # identify most significant SNP for each enriched pathway
  GOhap_labels <- GOhap %>% 
  group_by(pathway_name, symbol) %>%
  # slices each pathway and symbol combination to only select the row (SNP) which has the lowest adjusted p-value
  slice_min(order_by = .data[["adj_p"]], 
  # single value, in case of ties (draws) in max value, 
  # first n value is considered
            n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup() %>% 
  # highlights only the distinct positions for each label
  distinct(pos_cumul, symbol, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  GO_reg_scan <- ggplot() +
  # significant SNPs color-coded by pathway names
  geom_point(data = GOhap, 
                  aes(x = POS, y = -log10(adj_p), 
                      color = pathway_name), 
                  alpha = 0.5) +
  # labels of gene symbols associated with the GO terms
  geom_label_repel(data = GOhap_labels, 
                   aes(x = POS, y = -log10(adj_p), 
      label = symbol, color = pathway_name), 
  box.padding = 0.5, point.padding = 0.5, max.overlaps = 20,
  size = 3.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = unname(pals::alphabet2()), na.value = 'grey30',
                     labels = 
  \(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "No pathway found", x)) +
  # scale_x_continuous(label = chrom_ticks$CHROM, 
  #                    breaks = chrom_ticks$center_pos) +
  labs(title = "Enriched Biological Processes and associated genes\nmapped to different haplotype compositions (CONvs.FP)",
       x = paste0("Chromosome ", ChArm, " significant region"), 
       y = "-log10(adjusted P-value)",
       color = "Enriched Biological Process") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(legend.title = element_text(face = 'bold'))
  
  #print(GO_reg_scan)
  
  # ggsave(GO_reg_scan, filename = "../../Plots/GO_hap_try.jpeg", 
  #        dpi = 300, height = 12, width = 12)

#   GO_matrix <- ggplot(data = GOhap, aes(x = POS/1e6, y = pathway_name)) +
#     geom_point(aes(size = -log10(adj_p), color = -log10(adj_p)), alpha = 0.5) +
#   geom_label_repel(aes(label = symbol), size = 3, max.overlaps = 10, box.padding = 0.3) +
#   theme_cowplot()
# 
#   #print(GO_matrix)
#   
#   # maybe color heat plot by number of significant sites or by gene size
# 
#   heat_plot_data <- GOhap %>% group_by(pathway_name, symbol) %>%
#   # slices each pathway and symbol combination to only select the row (SNP) which has the lowest adjusted p-value
#   slice_min(order_by = .data[["adj_p"]],
#   # single value, in case of ties (draws) in max value,
#   # first n value is considered
#             n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>% ungroup() %>%
#   # symbol is a list, this makes symbol a factor
#   mutate(symbol = sapply(symbol,
# function(x) ifelse(length(x)>0, x[1], NA_character_))) %>%
#   mutate(symbol = factor(symbol),
#          pathway_name = factor(pathway_name))
# 
#   heat_plot_GO <- heat_plot_data %>%
#   ggplot(aes(x = symbol, y = pathway_name, fill = adj_p)) +
#   geom_tile(color = 'white', linewidth = 0.5) +
#   #geom_text(aes(label = sig_sites),
#    #         color = 'black', fontface = 'bold', size = 4) +
#   scale_fill_viridis_c(option = 'plasma', direction = -1) +
#   labs(y = "Biological Process", x = "Gene Symbol",
#     fill = "adjusted P-value",
#   title = paste0("Genes contributing to Enriched Biological Processes
#                  \nChromosome Arm: ", ChArm)) +
#   theme_cowplot() +
#   theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust=1, hjust=1))

  #print(heat_plot_GO)

  
  chrom_fig <- hplot + (ranks_plot/GO_reg_scan) + 
    plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")
  
  # GO_fig2 <- GO_matrix/heat_plot_GO + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")
  # 
  # out_list <- list(chrom_fig, GO_fig2)
  return(chrom_fig)
}

```

## Call functions for each chromosome arm

```{r}
coord_data_full <- readRDS(file = "../../../Big_data/FF_genomes_filtered.RDS")

chrom_arms <- as.character(unique(coord_data_full$CHROM))

for (chr in chrom_arms){
  
  freq_coords_chrom <- coord_data_full %>% filter(CHROM == chr)
  # Use this code for entire chromosome plots
  StPos <- as.integer(min(freq_coords_chrom$POS))
  EnPos <- as.integer(max(freq_coords_chrom$POS))
  
  rankscango_fig <- Reg_GOplot(chr, StPos, EnPos)
  # Save the rank and scan plot with GO integration
  ggsave(rankscango_fig, filename = paste0("../../Plots/fullhapGO_", chr, ".jpeg"), 
            dpi = 400, height = 17, width = 22)
  
  # remove outplots list to save memory
  rm(freq_coords_chrom, StPos, EnPos, rankscango_fig)
}
```
